description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation = one outer sample; the outer L1's score for a candidate is a COMPOSED fitness (per campaign.json::scoring, computed by inner_recursion._compute_proxies) — not one number thrown away from a signal-rich campaign. Shape = lift core x bounded quality modulator x efficiency modulator: ((headroom_lift+1)/2) * max(0.6, cleanliness*diversity_health) * (0.7 + 0.3*clamp(delta_per_dollar/6)). GOVERNING LAW: every term must carry a CANDIDATE GRADIENT (vary across the meta-prompt candidates being compared) — the two proxies retired earlier (rounds_to_N, a per-seed cost multiplier) died precisely because they were constant across candidates or a seed-property, so a flat term earns nothing and is cut in tuning. LIFT CORE: headroom_lift = best-discovered depth normalized by the task's own headroom (target-origin), which removes origin-strength bias so a config compares across inner tasks of different difficulty. It reads the inner cycle's best-DISCOVERED candidate (θ-LCB of the best candidate the inner search FOUND, discounted by its SE), NOT the best it CROWNED — the crowned frontier lags at small inner budgets, so the discovered level is the sensitive signal. The whole trajectory is ONE space (θ-implied ability where the ruler is warm, else raw accuracy) so no delta subtracts across scales; levels are NOT floored at origin, so a regressing meta-prompt yields a negative delta the outer steers away from (recentred (delta+1)/2 so regression<no-op<improvement stay distinct). QUALITY MODULATOR (penalties modulate, never dilute — floored at 0.6 so a broken campaign is discounted <=40%, never sign-flipped): cleanliness = 1 - mean-per-round(inner degraded/unscoreable rate + meta-fault self-heal rate + the outer meta-prompt's own malformed-output rate) — the self-heal rate is the share of a round's inner candidates that tripped self-healing for a meta-prompt-owned reason (any validation failure e.g. a hallucinated node, or an operator-terminal runtime failure), so any inner self-heal is transmitted upward as a penalty; a transient-transport self-heal is owner=L1 and excluded (provider noise, not the meta-prompt's fault); diversity_health = 1 - mean-per-round(no-op+duplicate share) penalizes mode collapse. EFFICIENCY MODULATOR: delta_per_dollar = best-depth / inner cost_usd — candidate-specific numerator, so (unlike the retired per-seed cost multiplier) it carries a gradient: a verbose meta-prompt burns more for the same lift and scores lower. EMITTED BUT HELD OUT of the v1 formula until a validation read confirms candidate gradient here (avoids re-baking a flat term): rounds_improved_frac, delta_per_candidate, delta_per_second, after_N_rounds_delta (superseded by headroom_lift in the core but kept as a raw observation), rounds_to_N (constant while origin<target is unreachable in 2 rounds; still narrated), and first_round_delta (collinear with headroom_lift — max(levels) includes levels[0], so whenever round 1 is the best round the two terms double-count one number; re-admit only if a validation read shows early-speed variation the core misses). ACCEPTANCE is empirical: the composed fitness must hold the C3 gate proxy_lift_corr>=0.6 — a term that degrades it is dropped. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (origin sits below target — clear headroom; gsm8k retired because its origin aces the target). The numeric target lives ONLY in inner_benchmark_config.target_score — never restate it in prose. n_samples_per_inner_round = 24, scored IN FULL per candidate (inner_recursion sets sp_budget_ttest = bank size): drawing more than we score just widens the θ-LCB and starves the signal, so draw == measure. Do NOT thin it: PoBB eliminates losers early (~14 samples), so only the WINNER is scored on the full bank — and the winner's θ-LCB is exactly the number headroom_lift reads. Cutting 24->18 buys ~7% of inner wall time (backend calls are only ~29% of it; ~62% is optimizer latency) and pays ~15% wider SE on the one statistic that matters, so it is a strict loss. ROUND BUDGET = max_inner_rounds 7 (the CEILING) x inner_lives {start:5,cap:7} (the stall brake): a compounding inner campaign banks its way to 7, a fully-stalling one does exactly 5 and dies, so depth is bought only where it pays. inner_n_variants MUST be >=2, else each inner round explores a single candidate and the discovered `levels` trajectory degenerates. PANEL = 7 seeds: one above the elimination_n_min (6) coverage floor, so a single errored inner campaign no longer drops the round under it (arm A lost seed-5 to an uncaught empty l2_context response and the round went sub-floor). Raise to 8 for a decisive/distributable run. Added depth roughly doubles inner spend, so the outer spend cap (campaign.json::spend_budget_usd) is sized to fit; the INNER cap is derived from n_rounds (inner_recursion.INNER_SPEND_PER_ROUND_USD), never pinned, or it would bind before max_rounds and bind earliest for the verbose candidates delta_per_dollar exists to penalise.
